description.other: Create a no-auth Microsoft Learn MCP declarative agent, use Development > Add Skill without enabling Frontier, reject testSkill, create agent-scoped test-skill, verify its files and manifest registration, provision, and preview the same agent in Copilot Chrome. UI interactions recorded on CY261104; common setup, account login, provision and preview steps reuse da-mcp-remote-none-preview. Container workspace cleanup is owned by vscuse; the provisioned test app remains in the configured M365 test tenant.
